title.narrative: Health Sector M&E Capacity Building IDF

description.narrative: The development objectives of the proposed IDF are to: (i) enhance skills of the Ministry of Health, health sector managers, and other stakeholders in results-oriented M&E in the health sector, (ii) contribute to the development of in-country training capacity in results-oriented M&E. Increasing the quality of M&E in the Kyrgyz Republic will contribute to greater accountability over the allocation of budget and donor funds targeted for health improvement and poverty reduction activities in the context of the recently launched sector-wide approach (SWAp). Improved M&E, inter alia, is expected to contribute to more effective implementation of the Manas Taalimi Health Sector Strategy which forms the basis of the SWAp, to enhanced linkages between the health sector strategy and the National Poverty Reduction Strategy (NPRS), and greater emphasis on reaching the health Millennium Development Goals (MDGs). In addition, strengthening M&E will facilitate implementation of program-based budgeting which is a key instrument to improve governance in the entire public sector. TF057893 The objectives of the Project are to: (a) enhance skills of the Ministry of Health (MoH) of the Recipient, health sector managers, and other stakeholders in results-oriented monitoring and evaluation (M&E) in the health sector; and (b) contribute to the development of in-country training capacity in results-oriented M&E.
